summary.text: Eric Tarr is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 4 since December 2018 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A physical therapist and business owner, he has served as president of the West Virginia Physical Therapy Association.

paragraphs.text: Eric Tarr's career experience includes working as a managing member and founder of Tarr Holdings and as owner of Generations Physical Therapy.
He served as president of the West Virginia Physical Therapy Association.
Tarr took office in the State Senate on December 1, 2018, succeeding Mark Drennan.
He chaired the Senate Finance Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Agriculture, Education, Judiciary, Natural Resources, Military, Pensions and Workforce committees.
